writtenBy: agent (Claude), on the owner's behalf, from the règlements' committed text layer (`<plot>/regulation/pages.jsonl`, the PDF's own text, page by page) and the five plots' recorded captures; never from an extraction result

handCheck.how: 002.9 step 1 (the contract: a person, against the PDF read at the page): open each PDF at the page of every row whose `handChecked` is false, check value, page and key phrase, compare the PDF's sha256 with `<plot>/regulation/meta.json`, then set `handChecked: true` per row and fill `by` and `date` here. A value changed after a run is recorded as changed, with the reason, in 002.9's Outcome.

judgement: 002.9 DEC-4: per required row, a rule of the extraction with the same kind, statement and sector whose limit equals one of `limitAnyOf` exactly (value, unit, base), whose page is within `pages`, whose passage contains one of the key phrases (whitespace, ligatures, apostrophes and the definition asterisk normalised), and whose conditions or exceptions contain each `expectedConditions` phrase. Extras are listed, never failed. A `forbidden` row fails when any rule matches it. A rule the table says is not regulated must come back as a `not_regulated` rule with its passage.
